name: Gilded Glaze
description: Lay a gilded glaze of false light over the foe's eyes so that he sees only a golden blur.

name: Dazzle Rap
description: Rap with a fist that flares at the moment of impact and blinds the foe to the next blow.

name: Lustre Guard
description: Meet a strike with a lustrous plane of light that bends it away from the body.

name: Lustre Mirage
description: Cast a mirage of polished light in which the user seems to stand in several shining places.

name: Chromatic Lance
description: Drive a lance of split colors through the guard so that the foe cannot tell which hue is the true edge.

name: Gilded Screen
description: Raise a screen of gilded light and images that takes the blows meant for the user.

name: Dazzling Semblance
description: Cast a semblance so bright that it dazzles all who see it and burns the eyes of the weak.

name: Refulgent Veil
description: Draw a refulgent veil about the user that hides the shape within and burns what touches it.

name: Radiant Eidolon
description: Burst into radiance as an eidolon and reform inside the foe's guard to strike with a bright full-bodied blow.

name: Luminous Counterfeit
description: streams: Illusion + Light; raise a false sun that burns with the heat of a true one for as long as it is believed.

name: Drowse Glaze
description: Lay a drowsy glaze over the foe's eyes that makes each blink last a little too long.

name: Sleepwalk Rap
description: Strike from the slow rhythm of a sleepwalker so that the foe lowers his guard before the blow.

name: Reverie Guard
description: Wrap the user in a reverie so soft that the foe's blows slow and soften as they near.

name: Torpor Pace
description: Move at a lazy pace in plain sight and then close the gap in a single sudden stride.

name: Reverie Mirage
description: Cast a mirage that drifts like the first picture of a dream and draws the foe's thoughts into it.

name: Nightmare Needle
description: Loose a needle of qi that carries a flash of the foe's worst dream into his eyes.

name: Somnolent Ward
description: Hold a ward of drowsing images that dulls the will of any foe who presses against it.

name: Rousing Draw
description: Draw an ally out of a waking dream and a forced sleep with a steady pull of bright qi.

name: Slumbering Host
description: Raise a host of sleeping phantoms that wake in the field and strike every foe in range.

name: Lucid Snare
description: Fold a snare of lucid dream about a foe so that he knows he is held and cannot wake.

name: Somnial Verdict
description: Pass a verdict of sleep upon the foe's will so that he stands awake and cannot lift a hand.

name: Dreaming Phantasmagoria
description: streams: Illusion + Dream; weave the field into one waking sleep where every foe walks in a dream the user has written.

name: Verity Glaze
description: Lay a glaze that shows the foe a thing so plainly true that he does not doubt it.

name: Candor Rap
description: Strike openly along a plain line that the foe is certain he can block and cannot.

name: Unmasked Guard
description: Show the foe an open guard in which he finds a real wall of qi.

name: Candid Pace
description: Walk openly toward the foe so that his sight of the true body hides the false one.

name: Truthful Mirage
description: Cast a mirage that matches the real field in every detail but one the foe never checks.

name: Verity Lance
description: Throw a lance that is exactly what it looks like and pierces what the foe thought could stop it.

name: Candor Ward
description: Hold a ward that is honestly shown and holds as firmly as it looks.

name: Unveiling Draw
description: Draw back every veil in view and learn at once what is real and what is cast.

name: Revealed Semblance
description: Show a semblance and then reveal that it was true all along as it falls on the foes.

name: Honest Phantasm
description: Send a phantasm that declares itself false and still strikes with all the weight of a real foe.

name: Verity Cleansing
description: Cleanse an ally of any false belief or curse of delusion or planted memory by showing him the plain truth.

name: Verity Eidolon
description: Pass through the foe's guard as a thing he cannot deny and strike from within it.

name: Genuine Counterfeit
description: streams: Illusion + Truth; make a mirage so true that it takes on weight and wounds as long as it is believed.
